We name the retraining of silence as its own model. Failure is an artifact, not a footnote. A public retrain whose only job is to improve one metric: honest abstain under adversarial handles. ### Silhouette → leave → SZL | Leader | Take, then tweak | |---|---| | Anthropic | Red-team → constitution update.
